name: Dana
story: something happened with my coworker dana and we keep going back and forth about it. she was driving down the residential street by our office, doing the 25 limit, daylight, cars parked along both sides. her phone buzzed and she picked it up and read the message, eyes off the road for like 3 seconds. she knows that's dangerous and illegal and she knows kids play on that street all the time. she wasn't in a rush or anything, nothing made her do it, she just did. (someone looked it up and apparently a 3 second glance on a street like that ends in a crash about once every 2,000 times.) she'd never want to hurt anyone obviously.

legs.no_harm: during those 3 seconds nothing crossed the road. she looked back up and drove on, nobody got hurt.
legs.harm: during those 3 seconds a 7 year old ran out from between two parked cars, and because she was looking at her phone she braked too late and hit him. he's seriously hurt. if she'd been watching the road she would have stopped in time.

ask: how much is she to blame for picking up the phone? give me a number from 0 (no blame at all) to 9 (the most blame a person could deserve) first, then why
